row.evidence: Constant Contact users are invited one by one by the Account Owner (Account Manager or Campaign Creator roles); OIDC single sign-on exists only for Teams & Partners multi-account customers, and no SCIM endpoint is documented in the knowledge base or the V3 API reference.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM: the knowledge base (sitemap searched) and the V3 API reference document only manual user invites, deactivate, reactivate and delete in Settings > Manage users. SSO is OpenID Connect (any OIDC IdP, configured with a discovery URL, client ID and secret) for Teams & Partners multi-account organisations, a sales-led offer; adding SSO users there needs Support to enable it, and users are invited rather than provisioned. Okta's only listing is 'Constant Contact by Aquera' (third party, does not change status). Plans are Lite (1 user), Standard (3 users) and Premium (unlimited users), billed monthly by contact tier; the pricing page returned a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) to every tool, so no prices were captured. The V3 API has a partner-only call that creates a user under an SSO-enabled client account. Status none by absence (confidence medium).

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: The knowledge-base plan comparison table (embedded data) lists 1 user for Lite. Billing is monthly by plan and contact tier, with prepay discounts.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: The knowledge-base comparison table (embedded data) lists unlimited users.

plans.name: Teams & Partners (multi-account)
plans.notes: Multi-account organisations with subaccounts; OIDC SSO configured under Accounts > Billing & settings.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the knowledge base or V3 API reference. Users are added only by the Account Owner through email invites; in SSO-enabled Teams & Partners accounts Support must enable user adds and users are still invited.

endpoints.purpose: Get the user privileges of the access token's user
Create a partner client account (technology partners only)
Create a user under a partner's SSO-enabled client account (partners only)

rate_limits.text: 429 returned when the request rate limit is exceeded; the limit itself is not stated in the reference.

user_api.notes: The public V3 API manages contacts, lists and campaigns. For ordinary accounts the only user call is GET /account/user/privileges (the token holder's own privileges). Technology partners can create client accounts and create users under SSO-enabled client accounts; there are no documented list, update, deactivate or delete user endpoints.

okta.notes: Only listing is 'Constant Contact by Aquera' (third-party connector); no Constant Contact-built OIN app found.

entra.notes: No Constant Contact tutorial in the Microsoft Learn SaaS app tutorial index (toc.json). The SSO article shows Entra configured as a custom OIDC app registration.

fallbacks.notes: jit false: SSO users must be invited first (each accepted invite creates the account).
